deviations: platform-tools pin mechanism differs from the dispatch instruction: 'platform-tools;37.0.1' is not a valid sdkmanager package ID (verified against repository2-3.xml). Implemented direct download of platform-tools_r37.0.1-linux.zip with SHA-1 verification against the repository XML - a strictly stronger pin.
sdkmanager timeout: --timeout=600 is not an sdkmanager option (verified in the shipped jars). Used the coreutils 'timeout 600' wrapper.

License RUN: 'set -o pipefail' on 'yes | sdkmanager --licenses' fails in this base because yes dies with SIGPIPE (141). Implemented the intent via a pre-written acceptance file redirected to sdkmanager stdin plus two postconditions (confirmation grep on the logged output; android-sdk-license file present).
ENV block split into two instructions because Buildah does not expand ${VAR} from earlier entries of the same ENV instruction (Docker does). Documented with an inline NOTE.
Repo gradlew is CRLF on disk (Windows checkout); verification CR-stripped it in-container. Not a Containerfile defect; Linux CI checkouts produce LF.
